texts: Week 4 Menu is up. Three quarterbacks and five lead backs are off the menu, Jaylen Warren is a top-12 back Thursday with Dowdle on two missed practices, and Jayden Daniels sits outside the top 24 until he practices. Start Warren. Let's look into it. #HereWeGo #RaiseHail

QB. Tier 1: Allen. Tier 2: Jackson, Lawrence. Tier 3 opens with Hurts and Burrow, and Burrow gets JAX at home, the softest quarterback spot of the week. Start all five. #BillsMafia #RavensFlock #DUUUVAL #FlyEaglesFly #WhoDey

QB tier 3, continued: Shough, Maye, Prescott. Shough threw 4 scores vs LV and gets a Monday night without Etienne. With Daniels unready, Marcus Mariota is the WAS quarterback on the menu; stream him in London if you are stuck. #Saints #NEPats #DallasCowboys #RaiseHail

RB. Tier 1: Gibbs, Robinson. Tier 2: McCaffrey, Taylor, Cook. Gibbs had 164 scrimmage yards and 3 scores last week and draws the defense that has allowed the most points to backs. Start all five. #OnePride #DirtyBirds #FTTB #ForTheShoe #BillsMafia

RB tier 2, continued: Henry, Walker, Jeanty, Brown. Jaylen Warren is RB11 with 90 percent of the snaps and 20 touches with Dowdle out, and Dowdle has not practiced this week. Start Warren as an RB1 Thursday. #RavensFlock #ChiefsKingdom #RaiderNation #WhoDey #HereWeGo

WR. Tier 1: Chase. Tier 2: Smith-Njigba, St. Brown. Smith-Njigba's 37.9 percent target share leads the league by four points, and St. Brown gets a CAR secondary missing two starters on Sunday night. Start all three. #WhoDey #Seahawks #OnePride #KeepPounding

WR tier 3: Lamb, Flowers, Olave, London, Collins (Q). Collins has not practiced since the hamstring and needs a session by Friday; have a backup ready. Flowers is off the snap count. Start the other four. #DallasCowboys #RavensFlock #Saints #DirtyBirds #HTownMade

TE tier 1: McBride, Bowers, Warren. Specials: Hubbard (20 carries, every first-half snap) start as your RB2; Aaron Jones Sr. (78 percent of the carries) start as a flex; Downs (targets 3, 9, 11) start as a WR2. #BirdGang #RaiderNation #ForTheShoe #KeepPounding #Skol

Off the menu. Caleb Williams (hamstring, 3 to 4 weeks): pivot to Jared Goff. Baker Mayfield (thumb, 3-plus weeks): pivot to Sam Darnold. De'Von Achane (ACL, IR): pivot to Ollie Gordon II, 84 percent of the snaps after he left. #DaBears #OnePride #GoBucs #Seahawks #PhinsUp
Full menu, all tiers, updated Friday with the injury report. Follow @FF_ChefHazy for the rest of the week's calls, and repost this for your league.
